scenarios.name: Explain a failed listening start prominently
scenarios.given: microphone recording startup fails before capture can begin
scenarios.then: a prominent alert explains the actual failure, recording stays stopped, and the user can dismiss it and open recording settings

manual.reason: The simulator exercises the failure UI, not real iPad microphone or speech-engine compatibility.
steps: On the affected iPad, allow microphone access and tap Start listening; record the full error, model, OS and app build.
On a supported iPad, verify successful capture even when AI summaries are unavailable; inspect current microphone transcript and opt-in playback.

scenarios.name: Cancel preparation without a false failure
scenarios.when: the user cancels preparation before a delayed permission/model callback returns an error
scenarios.then: capture returns to idle without a startup failure, including when the late callback throws a normal error rather than CancellationError

scenarios.name: Keep recording independent of summary AI
scenarios.given: no summary AI model is configured but speech capture is supported
scenarios.then: recording begins without requiring summary AI or starting a remote summary request

manual.reason: A stand-in recorder cannot establish microphone, on-device speech compatibility or retained audio on physical hardware.
steps: Run MobilePhysicalCaptureUITests/testPhysicalMicrophoneTranscriptionAndSavedAudioPlayback on an attended physical iPhone/iPad with LISTENTOME_PHYSICAL_AUDIO_ACCEPTANCE=1 and attended human or public synthetic speech; require the empty transcript before Start and reject earlier test phrases.
Verify Listening, current microphone transcript text, Stop, retained Play/Pause and source-matched native screenshots; preserve any real startup error.
Confirm no remote summary is invoked when Auto and speech correction are off; keep this separate from summary AI eligibility.

scenarios.name: Use available on-device dictation when advanced speech is unsupported
scenarios.given: an iPhone or iPad cannot use advanced SpeechTranscriber but supports the selected language with on-device dictation
scenarios.when: live recording or received Watch audio prepares its local transcription module
scenarios.then: preparation provides the dictation module with its audio format and time-indexed results, supported advanced speech remains preferred, and unsupported language or cancelled asset preparation never starts audio or routes speech to a remote provider

manual.reason: Native adapter tests do not prove model download, microphone recognition or file-transcription accuracy on older hardware.
steps: On the connected iPad Pro4, preserve the failed installed-build recording test and actual unavailable-transcription screen before installing the changed app.
Run the physical capability report, then verify actual new microphone words, Stop and opt-in playback on the dictation fallback; only play synthetic speech after Listening is confirmed.
Recheck the supported iPhone advanced speech path; Watch remains excluded and paired-device acceptance remains required.

scenarios.name: Deliver local speech results without an eager extra queue
scenarios.given: live or file speech results include provisional and final text with audio ranges
scenarios.when: the consumer reads results, stops delivery or cancels
scenarios.then: ordered text, finality and timestamps are preserved while stopping or cancellation prevents reading ahead into an extra result backlog

scenarios.name: Offer and detect languages supported by the active local speech modules
scenarios.given: an iPad uses on-device dictation for some or all transcription languages
scenarios.when: the language picker or Automatic language detection reads supported languages
scenarios.then: dictation-supported languages appear with correct local installed/downloadable status, advanced speech remains preferred where supported, and reading the catalog does not download a detector model

scenarios.name: Check recording support before offering Start
scenarios.given: a device cannot capture the selected language, is a simulator or has denied microphone access
scenarios.when: the Live view opens or language and foreground state change
scenarios.then: Start remains disabled with the specific reason and applicable recovery; supported on-device dictation is allowed independently of summary AI, and late obsolete checks cannot enable an unsupported choice

scenarios.name: Do not import a shared conversation after leaving the foreground
scenarios.given: a foreground capability check is waiting while a shared conversation is queued
scenarios.when: the app backgrounds before that check completes
scenarios.then: the delayed foreground handler cannot replace the conversation or consume the queued share; the next current foreground can import it

scenarios.name: Keep Live and Summary controls reachable alongside compatibility help
scenarios.given: live recording is unavailable in a short iPhone viewport, with normal or accessibility text
scenarios.when: the user reads Live or Summary, scrolls to an offscreen model in the short-height fallback, and opens recording support details
scenarios.then: the cause and recovery stay visible, full instructions remain available in details, model and recording controls remain reachable, and unsupported capture never requests the microphone
